title: Leverage Is Not Reach: A Control-Window Law for Single-Neuron Steering in Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability and control of neurons in large language models. It establishes a mathematical 'control-window law' for steering model behavior. Although it uses safety refusal (refusal of harmful instructions like fraud or cyberattacks) as its primary complex test case to validate its findings, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or ethical/moral reasoning frameworks.
